title: The Sales Type column shows after Status, with no value on summary rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it has one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour (Tech Time 2.00) and one part sold at $50.00; "Sales Representative - Labor" reads {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" reads {Sales-rep-B}; it was invoiced today.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with the Sales Type column off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a Sales Type column shows right after Status, and before Location when the Location column shows. Neither representative's summary row nor the Totals row shows a Sales Type value: the representative's name cell and the Totals cell stretch across the Sales Type column.

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, S18-R13), places Location right after Status. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD (answer 26, quoted below): the order is Status, Sales Type, Location. This case follows PRD version 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R19: “An invoice row carries a "Sales Type" column, after Status and before Location (Status, Sales Type, Location), reading "Labor", "Parts", "Part Sales" or "Labor, Parts".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 26: “26. (a) Status, Sales Type, Location.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 9 browser walk: “turn on → column after Status, rep and Totals merged cells span it”
